articles.translatedExcerpt: GANG PARADE held their final stage ``GANG PARADE LAST SAY HELLO!!'' at Zepp Haneda (TOKYO), marking the end of their 10-year career. Tickets for the last live show are sold out. The day's event was exclusively broadcast live on Niconico Live Broadcasting. Before the performance, a thin gauze curtain was lowered on the stage, and the overcrowded floor was filled with a buzz that was different from the usual one-man performances, such as calls for the GANG PARADE song that was being played as background music, as they approached the one-off day of their disbandment live. At 7:04 p.m., the electricity went out. A video of each member was projected on the screen, and each member said one word, "Ganpare, say hello," and then videos of their 12 years of activities, including training camp auditions and tours, were played, and all 11 members made the title call. articles.translatedExcerpt: flip-flops released their new single "sweet liar(s)" on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. It's only been a month since the release of a new EP that challenges the fusion of Midwest emo and electronics. This work, which was created to expand while incorporating more genres, expresses a new world view by combining the woody sound of an acoustic with the particle-like electronic sounds created by synths and granular processing. The song begins with the process of chopping up the vocals and the pad sound that surrounds it, which they have used in the new EP, and immediately draws the listener into the world of flip-flops. articles.translatedExcerpt: The electronic nenbutsu device ``Nirvana'' will be released on October 28, 2026 (Wednesday) from ``Light and Sound Specialty Store Hao Haoh Hao''. “Nirvana” is the second “Original Buddha Machine” following “Heaven” released in 2021. A Buddha machine (electronic nenbutsu machine) is an electronic audio device that records nenbutsu, Buddhist music, folk songs, etc., and is manufactured in various Asian countries, mainly China. You can play the sound with a single button, and the recorded sound plays repeatedly. In Japan, rather than being used as a religious tool, it is enjoyed as an interior decoration for homes and restaurants due to its pop-like appearance, and because of its musicality, artists use it in live performances and sampling, making it a cult favorite. It includes a large number of newly written songs and popular songs by artists who are active in Japan and abroad, and the Buddha Machine is a collection of gorgeous artists.

It has also been decided that the music video for this song will be premiered at 8pm on the same day. The original work ``#Gal to Gal no Yuri'', which is being serialized in the manga app ``Sunday Web'' (Shogakukan), is a youth comedy about a couple that begins when two gals, Yua and Rena, decide to start dating for ``a year'' on a whim. The lyrics for "Ima Aira View" were written by Emi Okamoto, who is also the main vocalist of the band Friends. The song was composed and arranged by beat maker/producer PARKGOLF. This work is a collaboration between two people who have a close relationship, such as Emi Kamomoto who participated in PARKGOLF's album "REO", and is composed of lyrics mixed with gyaru language.

articles.translatedExcerpt: FLYING KIDS, who welcomed new member Kaika (Vo/Kb) in the spring of 2026 and made a new start with eight members, will release a new digital single "Heiligenstadt no Will" on November 4th (Wednesday). Prior to this, the song was selected to be featured on Radio Takasaki's ``WEEKLY POWER PLAY.'' This work, which will be released on November 4th (Wednesday), is the first song released by the new group FLYING KIDS. It's a mellow funk number with impressive twin vocals by Takashi Hamasaki and Kaika, singing about the determination to quietly overcome sadness and move forward. The title of the song is an homage to Beethoven's ``Heiligenstadt Testament,'' in which he wrote his determination to live with music despite his suffering, as he was losing his hearing. articles.translatedTitle: Josiah Queen releases new AL with 14 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Josiah Queen released his new album "Damascus Road" on Friday, October 23, 2026. This work, which includes a total of 14 songs, focuses on the moment when an encounter with God changes your life, the hope found in weakness, and the journey toward unwavering faith. The album's title, ``Damascus Road,'' comes from the Biblical story of Saul's encounter with Jesus, which changed his life forever. This work depicts more than just a celebration of faith. A spiritual journey in which one faces hesitation and inner conflict, surrenders to oneself, accepts change, and begins a new path. Through honest songwriting rooted in personal experience and accessible folk-derived melodies, it resonates with people of faith as well as listeners searching for meaning and hope in life.

The music video "Honma Jakee ☆ Nande Nan ☆ Shirandono", which was shot in the Hiroshima Castle area, has been released on RCC TV's official YouTube channel. The music video released this time is ``Honmajakee☆Nandeyann☆Shiranbuto'', which is a Hiroshima dialect version of the chorus of their debut song ``Honmayade☆Nandeyanen☆Shiranbuto'' released in April. articles.translatedTitle: Laila!, new AL release containing 12 songs

This work depicts the elation of falling in love, the memories that remain in daily life, and the glow of youth that will never return. Centered on nostalgia and ongoing growth, he develops a personal sound that crosses R&B and pop. This album, which consists of 12 songs, was created mainly through Laila!'s own songwriting and production. articles.translatedTitle: DISH// releases MV for new song “Let’s wear jeans”
articles.translatedExcerpt: The music video for DISH//'s new song "Jipan Wearite Koze" has been released. This song is a song by Takumi Kitamura (Vo, G) that depicts the "small but supreme happiness" found in everyday life. It's an uplifting number that begins with light steps, as if taking a walk, and builds into a feeling of exhilaration that makes you want to run towards the chorus. A music video is a one-shot style video work shot on film. Following his previous work ``Aikotoba'', filmmaker Kazusa served as the director. In the studio where the performance takes place, the members perform while many staff members wearing jeans are assembling the set. Kitamura moving freely around the studio and the members performing are shown, and even though the scenes change one after another, the video unfolds seamlessly without any interruptions. It caught my eye...

Driven from within The music video, directed by Hideyuki Tanaka, centers on the two cast members running through various locations with all their might, interweaving impressive singing and performance scenes by the two Yuzu members.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Umiarashi released his first EP “HMU,AS I AIR” on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. This work includes a total of 7 songs with a rich variety, including ``Otona na ni Yuku'', which is a bold band arrangement of songs performed by Vo./Gt. Go Tanaka using a looper, ``Exploration Party's Night Song'', ``Kudaranae'', which he created with his former support members, and ``Daibakasha'', which was his first composition as Umiarashi. Starting with the lead single ``Aoi no Ao'', this album features technical and passionate performances that give a sense of each member's career path, as well as experimental arrangements. articles.translatedTitle: GLAY's latest album "Waiting for the reason to travel" has been released. Official interview with leader TAKURO also released
articles.translatedExcerpt: GLAY released their first new album in two years, ``Waiting for the reason to travel,'' on October 21st. This work, which is the 18th album in total, is a work that condenses the thoughts of GLAY as the "next move" presented after running through the 30th anniversary year. Up until now, the traditional style was to produce new songs, release the sound source, and perform the completed songs on tour. However, leader TAKURO, who completed the 30th anniversary, had a strong desire to "value GLAY and myself more in the rapidly changing times. Let's once question what we took for granted." So for this album, just like in the early days of the band's formation, they write songs, work them out in the studio, and then deliver them live to their fans. The album was completed with a return to basics approach of turning the polished songs into sound sources and releasing them into the world.

articles.translatedTitle: N Feni releases new song “Vintage Mansion”
articles.translatedExcerpt: N Feni released a new song “Vintage Mansion” on October 21, 2026. "Vintage Mansion" is a song written, composed, arranged, and produced by Feni himself. Looking at the city in the night breeze, feeling the sadness of seeing the lights of other people's lives, the story depicts a man's feelings wavering between his yearning to live there someday and his desire to run out the moment it comes true. Humor and irony are imbued with life-like words such as ``somen noodles in the summer and hot pot in the winter,'' while the ending is full of life-sized reality as he envisions a future where he can spend time with his loved ones. The music video for "Vintage Mansion" directed by Hiraki has also been released. Set in the streets of Tainan, Taiwan, the film depicts daily life in a nostalgic way while touring pastel-colored walls and buildings lined with cutely decorated fences called "iron window flowers."
